title: The Little Red Hen
author: Classic (Traditional)

hero.name: Little Red Hen
hero.description: Red hen character, classic illustrated farmyard bird protagonist
hero.source_note: Generic hen/chicken image from Boardmaker library should suffice for this traditional tale character

ambiguous.issue: Could mean the bird (noun) or the action of ducking down (verb)
ambiguous.reason: Duck is one of the three lazy animal characters in the story; bird meaning is correct

ambiguous.issue: Could mean cutting with scissors, a wound/injury, or cutting grain/wheat with a scythe
ambiguous.reason: In this story the hen cuts/harvests the wheat; a harvesting or cutting grain image is most accurate

notes: All 11 fringe words plus the hero hen are well-represented in standard Boardmaker/PCS libraries. The story's core repetitive sequence — plant seeds, cut wheat, grind flour, bake bread, eat bread — is captured in the fringe. The three animal characters (cat, dog, duck) are included so students can identify who refuses to help. 'work' from existing aac_extras is already covered by core 'help'; 'bake' and 'eat' from aac_extras are reused here as primary fringe words. The existing activity_images icons (hen, wheat, seed, flour, bread, cat, dog, duck) should be used directly rather than re-sourced. 'plant' and 'cut' are the only new symbols needed beyond existing assets.
